comment: SYNQED Business territory — the ONLY paths a Business PR may touch (phone-safety lock 3, deny-by-default). Every entry is a directory prefix and MUST end with '/'. Business i18n lives inside src/business/ — messages/*.json is in the thin bundle's dependency graph and stays phone-owned.
